shellCommands.command: cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -5 && ls node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/ 2>/dev/null && grep -n "prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts

cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== cache.js ==="; cat node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== types ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/ 2>/dev/null

sed -n 1630,1655p node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts; echo "=== default ==="; grep -n "partialPrefetching" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js | head

sed -n 1440,1460p node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js; echo "=== segment prefetch export ==="; grep -rn "'partial'" node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

cat node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/staged-rendering.d.ts | head -80; echo "=== RENDER_STAGES_BY_DATA_KIND ==="; grep -n "RENDER_STAGES_BY_DATA_KIND" -A 20 node_modules/next/dist/server/dynamic-rendering-utils.js | head -40

grep -rn "staticLinkData\|runtimeLinkData\|shellData" node_modules/next/dist/server/dynamic-rendering-utils.js | head; echo "=== defs ==="; grep -rn "staticLinkData" node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/app/app-segment-config.js | head -20; echo "=== consumers ==="; grep -rn "segmentConfig.prefetch\|config.prefetch\|\.prefetch === 'partial'\|'force-disabled'" node_modules/next/dist/server/ node_modules/next/dist/build/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map:" | head -20

echo "--- product.html (shell) contains 'Compact Widget'? ---" && grep -c "Compact Widget" .next/server/app/product.html; echo "--- full segments tree ---" && find .next/server/app/product.segments -type f | sed 's|.*|&|'

for f in $(find .next/server/app/product.segments -type f); do echo "=== $f ($(stat -c%s $f) bytes) : Compact Widget x$(grep -c 'Compact Widget' $f)"; done; echo; echo "=== product.rsc: x$(grep -c 'Compact Widget' .next/server/app/product.rsc)"; echo "=== meta ==="; cat .next/server/app/product.meta | head -c 2000

cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== FetchStrategy ==="; grep -rn "FetchStrategy" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/types.js | head

npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &
sleep 6
echo "=== / ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -o 'href="/product"'
echo "=== /product ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/product | grep -o 'Compact Widget\|Widget Carry Case\|Premium Widget'
echo "=== errors ==="; grep -i "error\|warn" /tmp/start.log | head
kill %1 2>/dev/null
cat .gitignore; echo "---"; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
